name: model-router
description: Claude Code model router: a Claude Code plugin for autonomous multi-model orchestration. Automatic Claude model routing that sets the right model and reasoning effort for every subagent, teammate and workflow agent, and the main conversation's effort per request, from any plugin, skill or agent, by task complexity, quality, speed and cost. It starts cheap, escalates work that comes back for a redo, learns from results in your setup, tracks new and retiring models, and checks the work before a turn ends.

routing_mode.title: Routing mode
routing_mode.description: auto (default): the model and reasoning effort of every subagent call are set automatically. advise: Claude is told the estimate but nothing is changed. off: no routing.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: What routing favors. balanced (default): the cheapest model strong enough for each subtask. quality: one step stronger. fast: one step lighter, and the quickest that qualifies.

max_tier.title: Strongest model allowed
max_tier.description: The most capable model subagents may run on: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Anything stronger is lowered to it. Leave as none for no cap.

agent_pins.title: Agents that name their own model
agent_pins.description: respect (default): an agent whose definition names a model keeps it, within the cap. override: those agents are routed by task like every other.

main_effort.title: Effort for the main conversation
main_effort.description: Raise the main conversation's reasoning effort for a request that looks complex or hardest, for that turn only. It never lowers what you set, and stays off when CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL is set or on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry, where an effort change re-reads the context uncached.

update_check.title: Check for Claude Code updates
update_check.description: Once a day, fetch the Claude Code changelog, the docs index and the model deprecations page from code.claude.com and platform.claude.com, and, with an Anthropic API key in the environment and no gateway, the account's model list from api.anthropic.com. Mention changes that affect this plugin, including models it routes to that are retiring.

verify_gate.title: Quality gates before finishing
verify_gate.description: Ask Claude once, before it finishes a turn, to (1) run the verifier when code changed and no test, lint or build ran afterwards, and (2) get a stronger agent's check when a hard request was answered by a weaker session model alone.
